products.english_title: Hatsune Miku x Mai Yoneyama "The Latest Street Style: Cute" 1/4 Scale Figure – Tokyo Figure Limited Edition
products.japanese_title: 初音ミク×米山舞 The Latest Street Style "Cute" 東京フィギュア限定版
products.tagline: Street-style Miku, in a rarer muted colorway.
products.description: Miku meets sneaker culture in this big 1/4 scale figure, based on Mai Yoneyama's street-style illustration. Stitched clothing, detailed sneakers and sweeping twin-tails are sculpted at a size that makes a statement on any shelf. This limited edition recreates the low-saturation colors of the original paired-up artwork, so it looks different from the standard release.
highlights: Based on art by Mai Yoneyama
Limited colorway, not the standard release
Fine detail in clothing seams, sneakers and twin-tails
products.bonus: Limited colorway (low-saturation, from the two-character key art)
